include_paths.description: The paths to import, as stored.

exclude_paths.title: Exclude Paths
exclude_paths.description: The paths to leave out, as stored.

tag_rules.title: Tag Rules
tag_rules.description: The tag rules, as stored (tags normalized, duplicates dropped).

reprocess.description:
`paths`: the selection changed, every version is fetched again at its commit; `chunking`: the
chunking changed (perhaps the tag rules too), every version is re-chunked and re-tagged from
what is stored; `tags`: only tag rules changed, every version is re-tagged from what is
stored; null: nothing changed and nothing is re-run, nothing is re-processed.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description:
The job re-processing every version (`/jobs/{id}`); one already queued for the library is
reused. Unchanged settings re-run the library's last re-processing job when it failed. Null
when nothing is to do or the library has no versions yet.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description:
The library's refs now, at the commits they serve: what the job re-processes (it reads the
versions again when it runs). Listed also when a queued job is reused.

UpdatedLibrarySettings.title: UpdatedLibrarySettings
UpdatedLibrarySettings.description: The settings as stored (normalized) and the job that brings every version in line.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: The ref as imported, e.g. `v1.4.0`, `main` or a commit SHA; case-sensitive.

kind.description: Whether the ref is a tag, a branch or a commit.

commit_sha.title: Commit Sha
commit_sha.description: The full commit SHA the ref resolved to at its last import.

imported_at.title: Imported At
imported_at.description: When the version was last imported.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: True for the version `/owner/repo` resolves to.

origin.description:
`auto` when the library's scheduled check imported it (retention may remove it), `manual`
when someone added it.

VersionOut.title: VersionOut
VersionOut.description: One imported version: the ref, what kind of ref it is, and the commit it stands for.

exactdocs__catalog__models__RefKind.title: RefKind
exactdocs__catalog__models__RefKind.description: What a version was imported from.

exactdocs__catalog__models__TagMatch.title: TagMatch
exactdocs__catalog__models__TagMatch.description: Whether an article needs any or all of the filter's tags.

exactdocs__catalog__models__VersionOrigi.title: VersionOrigin
exactdocs__catalog__models__VersionOrigi.description: Who asked for a version: a person, or the scheduled check (which may prune its own).

exactdocs__ingestion__models__RefKind.title: RefKind
exactdocs__ingestion__models__RefKind.description: What a requested ref turned out to be.

exactdocs__ingestion__models__VersionOri.title: VersionOrigin
exactdocs__ingestion__models__VersionOri.description:
Who asked for a version: a person (``manual``) or the scheduled check (``auto``).

Retention (``AutoSync.keep_last``) only ever removes ``auto`` versions.

exactdocs__retrieval__models__TagMatch.title: TagMatch
exactdocs__retrieval__models__TagMatch.description: How a tag filter combines its tags.
